dedupe_keys.name: semantic gis measurement code for offsets between railway dataset representations

description: Pavel Hrubeš at the Czech Technical University in Prague publishes measurement code for positional differences among five Czech railway-network representations. The September 2026 ZIP is freely downloadable under MIT. It contains an ordered PostGIS processing chain, source-specific loaders, an ontology with SHACL checks and a converter from the infrastructure manager’s railML representation. The method computes bidirectional point-to-line distances and weighted median offsets to assess whether networks can share topology at a chosen tolerance. This can prepare or check infrastructure geometry before network simulation. The original third-party datasets are excluded and retain their own licences. Decision notes preserve withdrawn conclusions, so older reported offsets must not be treated as current findings. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this tool. Numerical uncertainty, dependency compatibility and execution were not independently tested; the archive was not downloaded.
